greedy_states_3.note: Greedy, 3 inks, states west to east by label x. Stuck at ID after 4 states: its painted neighbors ['NV', 'OR', 'WA'] already use all three inks.

search_states_3.note: Exhaustive 3-ink search (most constrained region next, first region's ink fixed by symmetry) on NV and its 5 neighbors: the neighbors form a ring of 5 (odd), so the ring needs 3 inks by itself and NV touches all of them. Every branch dies: 9 backtracks, no 3-coloring. All 3^6 = 729 colorings also checked by brute force.

greedy_states_4.note: Greedy, 4 inks, same west-to-east sweep: stuck at KY after 29 states (its painted neighbors use all four inks), so it takes a fifth ink (plum). Finishing the sweep with 5 allowed, plum is needed 1 time(s): ['KY']. A valid 4-coloring exists (colorings.json); greedy just paints itself into a corner.

kempe_states.note: Kempe 1879 on the states: strip the westernmost state with <= 5 neighbors (counted among states still on the board), 49 times, then put them back in reverse order. 47 come back with a free ink, 2 need a chain swap; the 5-neighbour double swap never comes up here. Ends fully 4-colored (checked).

counties_4.note: A verified 4-coloring (SAT) painted west to east by label x.

world_4.note: Every country (all its parts, exclaves included, one ink) 4-colored (SAT, verified), painted west to east by label x.

benelux_3.note: France, Germany, Belgium take the three inks; Luxembourg touches all three, so it has none left. Four mutually touching countries (a K4) force a fourth ink.

kempe_fail.note: Region 0 has five neighbors [2, 7, 3, 6, 5] inked ['vermilion', 'ochre', 'prussian blue', 'sap green', 'ochre']. Both chains from 2 join, so Kempe flips the ochre-sap green chain at 7 and the ochre-prussian blue chain at 5 together and paints 0 ochre. The two chains are separate, yet regions 1 and 4 end on the same ink. Heawood's 1890 objection, on a 9-region map.

events.tag: five neighbors, all four inks used

kempe_fix.note: Same position, done safely: 2 chain flip(s) one at a time (each flip is always legal), re-checking after each, until an ink is free around 0; then 0 takes prussian blue. Ends with a valid 4-coloring (checked).

events.tag: five neighbors, all four inks used
